projects.name: proxyhut
projects.description: ProxyHut runs residential and mobile proxies on hardware you control—home broadband, office fiber, or your own 4G/5G SIMs. You keep the machine online; we run the hub and relays. Built for resellers, multi-account work, scraping, and geo checks. Free consultation; trials on spare gear are often possible.

projects.name: jasiri
projects.description: Jasiri puts an AI agent and a full Linux computer inside your Android phone. One APK shares files between chat and terminal; data stays on-device. Bring your own OpenRouter or OpenAI key. Sideload from jasiri.benlester.me—not on Google Play yet.

projects.name: fineract-rafiki-bridge-showcase
projects.description: Case study: an Apache Fineract ledger bridged to Rafiki Open Payments so wallets move money over Interledger while the bank ledger stays source of truth. Three-bank sandbox, CI, and a short walkthrough. Write-up at fineract-rafiki.benlester.me; live sandbox on request.

projects.name: sinc_crm
projects.description: CRM for education agencies placing students abroad. Sales manage inquiries and chats; managers watch the application pipeline. React on Cloudflare Pages, Hono API on Workers, Supabase for auth and data. Live demo with seeded manager, sales, and client accounts.

projects.name: wireguard-without-encryption
projects.description: Lab research on WireGuard for constrained IoT and SBC devices that lack hardware crypto acceleration. Measures CPU and throughput when both peers optionally skip transport encryption on hops you own. PC results: about 42% lower per-packet time; fast VM tunnels show little gain. Phone and board field work still open. Lab only—not a production VPN.

projects.name: signalstack
projects.description: Realtime chat demo in Go and Next.js. Hub-client WebSockets, public and private routing, graceful shutdown, and exponential-backoff reconnect. Built to show concurrent connection patterns—not a consumer chat product.

projects.name: youtube-commentguard
projects.description: Go CLI for YouTube creators to delete, hide, or shadowban comments through Data API v3. OAuth once, then batch comment IDs to stretch daily quota. Usable MVP with rebuild notes; parked after the first cut.

projects.name: universal-ev-evse-power-adapter-kit
projects.description: Hardware concept for a compact Type 2 / J1772 EVSE handshake adapter that extracts single-phase AC for RV and field loads (working name OAPE). Spec and architecture notes only—no PCB, firmware, or BOM checkout yet.

projects.name: stealth-browser-anti-bot-automation-lab
projects.description: Private research notes on anti-bot detection: TLS/JA3, browser fingerprints, CDP tells, and behavioral entropy. Maps stealth frameworks and an escalation model for automation labs. Notes only—no runnable harness in this repo yet.

projects.name: startup-devops-masterclass
projects.description: Syllabus and technical blueprint for a hands-on series: Git, GitHub Actions, Docker, and taking a small app from localhost to production. Separate from ai-engineering-from-scratch. Outline stage—recorded lessons not shipped yet.

projects.name: laptop-power-bank
projects.description: Hardware blueprints for a high-density laptop power bank (Stealth Brick): 4S pack, power-path switching, Dell ID pin, and USB-C PD. Draft design notes only—no finalized BOM or enclosure CAD yet.

projects.name: youtube-comments-scraper
projects.description: Python tool that scrapes YouTube comments with yt-dlp into CSV and SQLite. Can watch channels for new videos and refresh comment tables on a timer. Small POC seed—not a packaged product.

projects.name: termux-cursor
projects.description: Run Cursor Agent CLI natively on Termux (Android ARM64). Rebuilds Bionic native addons, stubs proprietary ones, and installs durable launchers—no proot, no glibc userland. Re-run apply-patches after each agent update.

projects.name: telegram-notifications-bot
projects.description: Small Go Telegram bot that checks a registration API and notifies users. Secrets load from .env. Early scaffold with the registration flow in place; not under active development.

projects.name: rpi-phone-kiosk
projects.description: Turn a Raspberry Pi OS Lite box into a phone-mirroring kiosk with Cage, scrcpy, and ADB. Modules cover a power-isolating USB Y-cable, udev attach, and a least-privilege kiosk user. Docs-first appliance build.

projects.name: quic-inside-linux-kernel
projects.description: C-first research toward a Linux in-kernel QUIC datapath that can match top userspace stacks on throughput while keeping kernel CPU costs low. Uses MsQuic and lxin/quic as references; includes lab benches and design notes.

projects.name: quant-research-lab
projects.description: Quantitative trading research lab: MetaTrader 5 as a dumb tick and execution pipe, Python for ingestion and backtests, DuckDB for storage. Replaces the marketlab-ai stub. Tick collector lands first; strategy work follows.

projects.name: opencode-termux
projects.description: Prebuilt OpenCode AI coding agent for Termux Android ARM64, plus a build script that compiles with Termux's patched Go. Avoids the faccessat2 crash from official linux/arm64 binaries. Packaging only—upstream is opencode-ai/opencode.

projects.name: natbridge
projects.description: Reverse SOCKS5/HTTP relay over QUIC for hosts behind NAT. An egress dials a public relay; clients use the relay as a normal proxy while traffic exits from the egress. Go PoC with scripted iperf labs; still in active development.

projects.name: iperf3-proxy
projects.description: Fork scaffold of iperf3 with planned SOCKS5 and HTTP CONNECT support on the client. Meant for measuring throughput through real proxies and reverse tunnels without a separate port-forward helper. Upstream snapshot is vendored; proxy paths are still being built.

projects.name: guardian-agent
projects.description: Blueprint for GuardianAgent: a tri-tier Facebook group moderation assistant. Paths cover a Chrome extension, a local Chromium wrapper, and a cloud browser instance. Concept and architecture only — no product code in this repo yet.

projects.name: google-gce-spot-vms-provisioner
projects.description: CLI that creates short-lived Google Compute Engine VMs for tests, batch jobs, and AI agents. Spot by default, required max run time, SSH key minting, and disks deleted with the VM so forgotten instances do not linger. Python tool (`gce-vm`); still gaining features from the roadmap.

projects.name: projects-command-center
projects.description: I use this private hub to inventory my GitHub repos, track status and tags, ship a portable agent kit, and publish the allowlisted public board (what-am-building / projects.benlester.me).

projects.name: cursor-termux
projects.description: Run the Cursor Agent CLI natively on Termux (Android ARM64) — no proot or glibc chroot. Supports the interactive TUI, login/resume, and phone-as-cloud-worker mode. Installer plus patch scripts for node-pty, SQLite, and Android tmp quirks.

projects.name: ai-content-moderation
projects.description: Small HTTP service that scores comment text with a Hugging Face sequence-classification model. Starlette/uvicorn API with local or Hub model load, plus Termux-oriented install notes. Prototype for offline-friendly moderation scoring.

projects.name: remoteTerminal
projects.description: Concept for remote Linux terminal access over WebSocket without SSH, including hosts behind NAT. README outlines use cases and security questions. Seed only — superseded in spirit by later PTY host work.

projects.name: ai-file-manager
projects.description: Product notes for an AI-assisted personal file manager: understand photos, videos, and documents enough to dedupe, suggest folders, and search by memory (“video next to a red car”). Starts with phone gallery cleanup. Concept and requirements only — no app code yet.

projects.name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
projects.description: Hands-on series plan to build an AI assistant platform from fundamentals: chat, RAG, semantic search, tool calling, web search, and a lightweight harness. Target outcomes include internal-data chatbots and small agent systems. Curriculum/outline stage.

projects.name: pty-shuttle
projects.description: PTY host with thin clients: spawn TUI programs (or a shell) and attach from CLI, Android, or a browser. Unix socket and WebSocket shuttles; not a cloud IDE and not an agent harness. Phases 0–3 done (host, LAN WebSocket, Android PoC); more RPC/status work planned.

projects.name: socks5server-go
projects.description: Go SOCKS5 server with optional reverse-tunnel relay for TCP CONNECT and UDP ASSOCIATE. Work tool for exposing a NAT-side proxy through a public peer. Related to the socks5-reverse-tunnel* experiments.
